text.text: Three roads lead to a SlashBlade: the crafting table is quick, the forge picks the blade type, the station is precise.

The forge works like a Tinker's anvil: a recipe list on the left - click an entry to choose what to forge, the odachi or the supreme great blade, and the choice is remembered by the block - then a blank of that type and one to three ingots of the same material on the right. Extra ingots only add durability, ten percent each.
The uchigatana and the shirasaya are not on the forge's list: craft those at a crafting table, or build them from parts at the station.

Station: one blade part, one handle part and one saya part, each of a different material if you like. The blade sets durability, attack, mining and trait; the handle scales durability, attack, attack speed and mining speed by Tinkers' percentage modifiers; the saya adds two tenths of its own blade attack.
Parts come from Tinkers' own stations: pour molten metal into a gold cast on the casting table, or hammer a non-castable material with the cast in the part builder.
Make a cast from gold ingots and a Tinkers' pattern in a crafting table; one cast lasts forever. The blade takes two materials, the handle and saya one each.
Both stations can be picked up; their contents spill out.
Fill the right column as well - a second blade, handle and saya - and all six slots forge the supreme great blade, where every number stacks: the full form of this mod.
